newsitem.title: JAPAN: EPA says negative about extra budget for economy.
newsitem.headline: EPA says negative about extra budget for economy.

text.p: Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso told a news conference on Tuesday that he is negative about forming a supplementary budget specifically aimed at stimulating the economy.
"It is desirable for the BOJ to maintain its easy credit policy for the time being," he said.
Aso said the economy has been recovering slowly but that the basic trend is firm.
"I am negative about forming a supplementary budget which is mainly aimed at helping the economy," he said.

Aso said economic indicators that have been announced recently show the economy is recovering gradually, although it is too early to say whether the driving force has completely shifted to private demand from public demand.
Japan's consumer and wholesale prices have been extremely stable despite a rise in import prices caused by the recent weakness in the yen.
